title: Reliance Brands Partners with Kim Kardashian's SKIMS for Indian Retail Expansion
summary: Expands luxury shapewear retail footprint in India via RBL.

blocks.content: Expands luxury shapewear retail footprint in India via RBL.

items: Reliance Brands Limited partnered with US shapewear brand SKIMS (co-founded by Kim Kardashian) for exclusive Indian retail distribution.
First SKIMS flagship store planned for Mumbai in late 2026.
